description: Fetch performance metrics for LinkedIn campaigns over a date range. Returns impressions, clicks, spend (USD and local currency), website conversions, one-click lead form submissions, landing-page clicks, video views, follows, reactions, comments, and shares. Pass campaign_ids for specific campaigns or use ad_account_id for account-level totals. Supports DAILY/MONTHLY/YEARLY/ALL time granularity and CAMPAIGN/CAMPAIGN_GROUP/CREATIVE/ACCOUNT pivots. Default range: last 28 days.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account ID/URN. Used when campaign_ids is omitted. Defaults to LINKEDIN_DEFAULT_AD_ACCOUNT.

campaign_ids.description: Campaign numeric IDs or URNs. Omit to report at account level.

end_date.description: End of date range. Default: yesterday.

start_date.description: Start of date range. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday, or NdaysAgo. Default: 28daysAgo.

name: li_get_campaign_performance
